UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Player account profile, privacy preferences, virtual wallet, and unlocked achievements.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase UID owning this profile.

leaderboardAlias.description: Public or pseudonymous alias shown on leaderboards.

showOnLeaderboard.description: Privacy toggle controlling whether user scores appear on the global leaderboard.

anonymousLeaderboard.description: Privacy toggle to mask display name behind a quiet chronicler alias.

autoCloudSync.description: Whether life progress automatically syncs to Firestore.

showOptionalEndOfLifeAds.description: Whether optional end-of-life supporter reward cards are displayed.

sparkles.description: Virtual currency earned from live streaming and optional life milestones.

totalLivesPlayed.description: Total completed or started lives across platforms.

unlockedAchievementIds.description: Bounded list of unlocked achievement identifiers.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

LifeSave.title: LifeSave
LifeSave.description: Complete cross-platform save state for an active or completed life simulation in Journal.

isAlive.description: Whether the character is still alive.

epitaph.description: Closing life reflection written upon passing.

stats.description: Map of core life attributes (health, happiness, intellect, appearance, creativity, karma).

appearance.description: Map of character avatar customization options.

socialChannel.description: Map of influencer channel handle, niche, tier, stream count, and gear level.

relationships.description: Bounded list of relationship state maps.

recentEntries.description: Bounded list of chronological journal entry maps.

achievedIds.description: Bounded list of achievements unlocked during this life.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Privacy-safe global leaderboard record showcasing a player's best life legacy.

characterName.description: Name of the character who achieved this legacy.

isPublic.description: True only when the user has opted into global leaderboard visibility.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on creation.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp() on update.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile, privacy settings, wallet, and achievement progress.

/users/{userId}/lives/{lifeId}.description: User-owned life simulation saves for cross-platform resume and legacy archive.

/leaderboard/{entryId}.description: Global opt-in leaderboard entries keyed by owner UID.
